entry.title: VSG Enchantment — Single
experienceTags: Pairings: Espresso, dark chocolate, bourbon or dark rum
entry.summaryHtml: Espresso, dark cocoa, cedar, leather, earth and black pepper arrive quickly in this short VSG perfecto. The Ecuador Sumatra wrapper sits over aged Dominican tobaccos for dense sweetness, roasted nuts and spice, while the tapered shape concentrates the opening before the 60-ring centre produces a much broader mouthful of smoke.
entry.noteHtml: Cigar Hut lists the exact 4.375″ × 60 Ashton VSG Enchantment single at A$44.
productionLines: Handmade in the Dominican Republic by Arturo Fuente
